## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía, Calle de Santa Isabel, Madrid, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofia.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Experience the art and culture of Madrid with a ticket to Museo Reina Sofia, one of the most iconic and innovative art museums in the world. With its stunning collection of modern and contemporary art, this museum is a must-visit for art enthusiasts, history buffs, and culture lovers.
>
> Discover the fascinating works of Pablo Picasso, Salvador Dali, and Joan Miró, among many other prominent artists of the 20th century. From the iconic Guernica by Picasso, a painting that has become a symbol of the horrors of war, to the mesmerizing playful sculptures by Alexander Calder, the museum's collection is an art lover's dream come true.
>
> The ticket includes an access to the museum’ wide range of temporary exhibitions that will enrich your experience and expand your knowledge of art and culture. Whether you're looking to discover new artists or gain a deeper understanding of the art world, this museum has something for everyone.
